title: NC circuits have polynomial size
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number and $L$ a language of Boolean strings. If $L$ is recognized by a family of well-formed circuits with fan-in at most two, polynomial size, and depth at most $b(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)^d$ on inputs of length $n$ for some natural number $b$, then there are natural numbers $a,k$ such that $L$ is recognized by a well-formed circuit family with fan-in at most two and size at most $a(n+1)^k$ on inputs of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is in $\mathrm{NC}^d$ (fan-in at most two, polynomial size, and polylogarithmic depth with exponent $d$)
